Title: [P0][backend][phase:1] Agent framework base classes
Description: Create multi-agent framework: config.py (AgentPipelineConfig with defaults 200K tokens/3600s timeout), models.py (ParseResult/AgentStepResult/ChunkInfo dataclasses), agents/base.py (BaseExtractionAgent with LLM call + JSON parse + retry logic), __init__.py (public API stubs)
Acceptance: config.py has AgentPipelineConfig with max_context_tokens=200000 and timeout_seconds=3600 | models.py has ParseResult with outline/characters/entries/agent_log fields | base.py has BaseExtractionAgent with run_on_chunks() method | __init__.py exports parse_outline and parse_outline_stream_events
Notes: Extends existing app.llm.agent Protocol pattern. BaseExtractionAgent should accept LLMStrategy + system_prompt + user_template and handle chunked input.

Title: [P0][backend][phase:1] Text chunking utility
Description: Create chunker.py: TextChunker class that splits long text into overlapping chunks. Token-aware splitting using tiktoken or simple char-based estimation (1 token ≈ 1.5 chars for CJK). Configurable chunk_size_tokens and overlap_tokens. Returns list of ChunkInfo with text/start_offset/end_offset/chunk_index.
Acceptance: TextChunker.chunk(text, max_tokens=50000, overlap_tokens=2000) returns list[ChunkInfo] | Single short text returns single chunk | Long text splits at paragraph/sentence boundaries | Overlap ensures context continuity
Notes: Use simple char estimation for CJK (1 token ≈ 1.5 chars). Split at paragraph breaks (double newline) first, then sentence breaks. No external dependency needed.

Title: [P0][backend][phase:2] Agent orchestrator (coordinator)
Description: Create coordinator.py: OutlineParsingOrchestrator that manages the full pipeline. Phase 1: run AnalysisAgent. Phase 2: run Structure/Character/Entry agents in parallel (asyncio.gather or sequential fallback). Phase 3: run ValidationAgent. Track per-agent timing/token usage. Support progress callbacks for SSE.
Acceptance: Orchestrator.run(text, config) returns ParseResult | Parallel extraction runs 3 agents concurrently | Each agent step logged in agent_log | Total duration and tokens tracked | Progress callback called per phase
Notes: Use existing LLM strategy from llm_task_preset_resolver. Resolve outline_parse task key or fallback to project default. asyncio.gather for parallel execution.

Title: [P0][backend][phase:2] Structure extraction agent + prompts
Description: Create structure_agent.py: StructureExtractionAgent extends BaseExtractionAgent. Extracts outline_md (story arc summary) and chapters[{number, title, beats[]}]. Handles multi-chunk input by accumulating chapters across chunks. Create prompts/structure_system.md and prompts/structure_user.md.
Acceptance: Agent extracts chapters with number/title/beats from input | Handles multi-chunk: accumulates chapters, deduplicates by number | Output matches existing outline contract: {outline_md: string, chapters: [{number, title, beats[]}]} | System prompt defines role and output JSON schema | User template has {{chunk_text}} and {{chunk_info}} placeholders
Notes: Output contract MUST match existing: {outline_md: str, chapters: [{number: int, title: str, beats: [str]}]}. This is critical for compatibility.

Title: [P0][backend][phase:2] Character extraction agent + prompts
Description: Create character_agent.py: CharacterExtractionAgent extends BaseExtractionAgent. Extracts character cards [{name, role, profile, notes}] from input. Deduplicates characters across chunks by name. Create prompts/character_system.md and prompts/character_user.md.
Acceptance: Agent extracts characters with name/role/profile/notes | Handles multi-chunk: deduplicates by name, merges profile info | Output matches CharacterCreate schema: [{name: str, role: str|null, profile: str|null, notes: str|null}] | System prompt defines extraction rules | User template has {{chunk_text}} placeholder
Notes: Output must match existing CharacterCreate: name (required 1-255), role (optional 255), profile (optional 40000), notes (optional 40000)

Title: [P0][backend][phase:2] Entry extraction agent + prompts
Description: Create entry_agent.py: EntryExtractionAgent extends BaseExtractionAgent. Extracts worldbuilding entries [{title, content, tags[]}] from input. Categories: 设定/伏笔/情节/世界观/魔法体系 etc. Deduplicates across chunks by title. Create prompts/entry_system.md and prompts/entry_user.md.
Acceptance: Agent extracts entries with title/content/tags | Handles multi-chunk: deduplicates by title, merges content | Output matches EntryCreate schema: [{title: str, content: str, tags: [str]}] | Tags from DEFAULT_ENTRY_TAGS plus custom | System prompt defines extraction scope
Notes: Output must match EntryCreate: title (1-255), content (max 40000), tags (max 80 items, each max 64 chars). Default tags: 设定/伏笔/情节

Title: [P0][backend][phase:2] Analysis + validation agents + prompts
Description: Create analysis_agent.py: AnalysisAgent analyzes input format/structure and returns extraction plan. Create validation_agent.py: ValidationAgent merges results from all extractors, validates chapter continuity, cross-references characters in outline vs extracted, ensures completeness. Create 4 prompt files.
Acceptance: AnalysisAgent returns content_types/structure_hints/recommended_strategy | ValidationAgent merges structure+characters+entries into ParseResult | Chapter numbers validated for continuity | Duplicate characters/entries removed | Missing chapters flagged in warnings
Notes: AnalysisAgent is lightweight — single LLM call. ValidationAgent may call LLM for gap-filling but primarily does programmatic merging.
